ios.desc:
Your phone is full of screenshots, saved posts and “you have to try this” tips you’ll never find again. TheLysts turns them into lists you can actually use — and lets you discover places, food and travel picks curated by real people, not algorithms.

Every list on TheLysts is made by a person. AI only does the typing.

■ SAVE ANYTHING TO A LIST IN SECONDS
Share a screenshot, a link, a PDF or a video from anywhere on your phone — Instagram, TikTok, Safari, Photos — and TheLysts reads it and builds the list for you.
• Pick 2 to 20 photos at once and get one organized list with names, details and photos.
• Share a “Top 10 restaurants in Lisbon” post or a travel blog — the spots are extracted and organized for you.
• Video works too: choose a clip and the items come out of it.
• You review every item before it saves. When AI isn’t sure two things are the same, it asks. You decide.

■ RECOMMENDATIONS FROM PEOPLE YOU TRUST
Skip the paid reviews and endless scrolling.
• Follow friends, food lovers and travel creators — their curated lists, not just their posts.
• Browse public lists on a map and find hidden-gem restaurants, cafés and spots near you.
• Get inspired by curated picks on any topic: city guides, weekend plans, books, movies, recipes, workouts and more.

■ LISTS THAT WORK THE WAY YOU DO
• Add photos, columns and rows — restaurant guides, travel bucket lists, wishlists, watchlists, gift ideas.
• Turn any list into a checklist with Tick and check items off as you go.
• Create a list by voice, then let AI fill in the details so it’s complete without the busywork.
• Reorder your lists, pin what matters, and keep each one private, shared or public — you decide who sees what.

■ PLAN AND SHARE TOGETHER
• Build group lists with friends — plan a trip, a dinner crawl or a weekend together.
• Share lists directly with friends or in group chats.
• Chat about items and join communities built around what you love.

■ FOR CREATORS AND EXPERTS
• Grow followers with lists people actually save.
• Earn ad revenue from your public lists.

■ WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE THELYSTS
• Save from screenshots, links, PDFs and videos — AI reads, you approve
• Real recommendations from friends and experts, not an algorithm
• Map-based discovery of places near you
• Private, shared or public lists — you control who sees what
• Group lists, chat and communities
• Monetization tools for creators and brands
